narration.text: I ranked 50 AI tools for YouTube, and only 5 are worth it.
Starting with number 5, Opus Clip quickly turns your long videos into viral shorts. It saves hours of editing and finds the best moments automatically, perfect for content creators.
Number 4 is Nvidia Broadcast. This free tool removes background noise and improves webcam quality. It is like having a professional studio setup for your audio and video.
Coming in at number 3, ElevenLabs generates realistic voiceovers in multiple languages. It brings your scripts to life with natural-sounding speech, making global reach easier than ever.
At number 2, Descript edits video by editing text, like a document. This makes video editing incredibly intuitive, cutting out mistakes as easily as deleting words.
And the number one AI tool for YouTube is TubeBuddy. It optimises your channel and video SEO, making sure your content gets discovered. It is essential for growth.
TubeBuddy is genuinely a game-changer for any creator. Which AI tool do you use most often for your YouTube channel?
